sources.title: LuffyTheFox/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Uncensored-Genesis-Hermes-V5-GGUF
sources.snippet: Introduction This item packages a Qwen3.6-based, MoE 35B model in GGUF format that was numerically repaired ("Genesis‑SVD") to recover signal from corrupted tensors and exposed as a multimodal image-text-to-text and conversational agent. The release targets users who need an uncensored, agentic model variant compatible with common GGUF runtimes and quantization workflows. What Sets It Apart ...

sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Uncensored-Genesis-Hermes-V7-GGUF Debuts Saying Yes
sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Uncensored-Genesis-Hermes-V7-GGUF is a new GGUF release from LuffyTheFox built on an uncensored Qwen3.6 base with Hermes agent data. It has 35B total parameters but activates about 3B per pass. The model handles text, images, and video in llama.cpp, LM Studio, koboldcpp, and other GGUF apps.
